verdict.rationale: Folk publishes its own structured API reference: resource-oriented REST endpoints, per-endpoint pages indexed in llms.txt, and a quick-start guide that walks through an example call to list groups. No evidence shows the reference is interactive, such as a try-it console or runnable request playground, and the OpenAPI spec paths all returned 404, so no machine-readable spec backs an interactive explorer. Missing for 10: an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable or executable examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration.
